WITH candidates AS ( SELECT run_id FROM ifj_app_run WHERE status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'DRAINING') AND run_id <> #{excludeRunId} AND heartbeat_at <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) - (#{staleMicros} * INTERVAL '1 microsecond')) ORDER BY heartbeat_at ASC, run_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE ifj_app_run SET status = 'CRASHED', stopped_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM candidates WHERE ifj_app_run.run_id = candidates.run_id

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT run_id FROM ifj_app_run WHERE status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'DRAINING') AND run_id <> #{excludeRunId} AND heartbeat_at <= strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now', printf('-%.6f seconds', (#{staleMicros} / 1000000.0))) ORDER BY heartbeat_at ASC, run_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} ) UPDATE ifj_app_run SET status = 'CRASHED', stopped_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f','now') FROM candidates WHERE ifj_app_run.run_id = candidates.run_id

WITH candidates AS ( SELECT run_id FROM ifj_app_run WHERE status IN ('STARTING', 'RUNNING', 'DRAINING') AND run_id <> #{excludeRunId} AND heartbeat_at <= DATEADD(MILLISECOND, -(#{staleMicros} / 1000), SYSUTCDATETIME()) ORDER BY heartbeat_at ASC, run_id ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY ) UPDATE ifj_app_run SET status = 'CRASHED', stopped_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() FROM candidates WHERE ifj_app_run.run_id = candidates.run_id
